# David Luengo Juárez — DLJ Tech

> David Luengo Juárez is an AI and automation consultant (founder of DLJ Tech / David Luengo Juarez LLC). He automates repetitive work for small and mid-sized businesses with AI workflows, custom apps and internal tools, working in Spanish and English. Core offer: a one-time 30-day paid trial (from USD 997), no lock-in, with a money-back guarantee if the results agreed in writing are not met. Industries: logistics, travel, restaurants, language education and health.

Primary language: Spanish (es). English (en) version available at /en/.

## Key facts
- Person: David Luengo Juárez — AI & automation consultant, bilingual ES/EN
- Company: DLJ Tech (legal name: David Luengo Juarez LLC)
- Services: AI & workflow automation; custom apps and internal tools; Chief Automation Officer as a Service
- Method: 1) Discovery of the 3-6 core processes, 2) Simplify and accelerate, 3) Automate
- Engagement: 30-day paid trial from USD 997 (one-time). Optional monthly plan afterwards, cancellable any time. No lock-in.
- Typical implementation time: 2-4 weeks
- Contact: form at https://tally.so/r/wk107o (reply within 48 hours)
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/david-luengo-juarez/
- GitHub: https://github.com/daluj
